thread:
Sam B.: heads up — planning a staged rollout for the geo cost-aware degrade. want to align on flags + canary windows before i write the spec
Priya R.: thanks. can you summarize the goal? (is this primarily cost, latency, or regulatory isolation?)
Sam B.: short: keep high-priority customers on full model, gradually shift low-priority traffic to smaller quantized variants in high-cost regions. fallback policy if latency > 300ms or error rate spike
Marco L.: curious about the canary signal set. do we use latency p50/p95 + user-impacted errors or a combined score?
Priya R.: combined score sounds right. propose: score = 0.6 * p95_latency_norm + 0.4 * error_rate_norm. thresholds: green < 0.5, yellow 0.5-0.8, red > 0.8
Olivia K.: also add model-quality check from eval harness (prompt set pass rate). don't want to silently degrade generation quality for billing reasons
Sam B.: good call. add quality as hard gate for customers flagged as "sensitive". non-sensitive customers go through A/B mix with explicit consent
Marco L.: A/B plan: 10% control (full model), 80% optimized variant, 10% fallback-tests. run for 48h sliding window. metric: business-quality delta (accept rate) + latency delta
Priya R.: rollout slices by region first: EU -> US -> APAC. EU gets 24h extended canary because of higher enterprise density
ops-bot: deploy request queued: /deploy rollout-geo-degrade v0.3 -> staging (sha:abc123). ETA 10m
Sam B.: experiment config (draft):
```
flags:
  geo_degrade_v0.3: {
    partitions: [EU, US, APAC]
    canary: {EU: 24h, US: 48h, APAC: 72h}
    ab_split: {control:10, variant:80, fallback_probe:10}
    signals: [p95_latency, error_rate, eval_pass_rate]
    fallback_policy: "try-compatible-quantized -> fallback-region -> degrade-to-cache" 
  }
```
Olivia K.: question: "fallback-region" — do we want cross-region failover or local smaller model first? i vote local smaller model first, then cross-region if SLOs still violated
Sam B.: agreed. modify fallback_policy to: local-quant -> cross-region-full-model -> degrade-to-cache. also add per-tenant opt-out flag `tenant_force_full`
Marco L.: telemetry: tag events with rollout_bucket and region, and emit per-tenant regression alerts. set automatic rollback if business-quality delta < -3% at 95% CI
Priya R.: operational runbook items: ops pager if red for 2 consecutive 5m windows, immediate rollback if red persists 15m. include manual kill-switch in console + `!rollback` slash command in #release-war-room
Sam B.: i'll update the spec and send for review by EOB. next step: product sign-off + solutions eng to prepare customer outreach for opt-ins
Olivia K.: thumbs up. small ask: add a prompt-sample audit snapshot each hour for the first 48h to inspect regressions manually :eyes:
Sam B.: noted. adding `prompt_audit_hourly: true` for initial bake
Priya R.: thanks — please link the spec doc when you post it. marking this thread as the coordination source for rollout ops
Sam B.: posting doc in #docs + sending to stakeholder list. if no objections by EOD we'll kick the EU canary tomorrow morning :rocket:
